scratch_accounting.lz4: 3 * advertised block size + 65536; source plus worst linked-block destination
scratch_accounting.output: min(sum(compressed decoded-batch ceiling or exact uncompressed lengths), normalized ceiling) + 32-byte zstd slack
scratch_accounting.concurrency: backend contexts run sequentially; output plus maximum admitted scratch checked before context creation
scratch_accounting.limit: requested/reported Vec capacity plus conservative pinned source scratch; not allocator metadata, stack, caller-retained buffers or RSS
